basic_details.job_title: NITTTR Junior Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Technical Teachers' Training and Research (NITTTR), Kolkata, an Institution Deemed to be University under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, is engaging one Jr. Consultant (Civil) purely on a contractual basis at a remuneration of Rs.25,000/- for a tenure of one year. The post needs a Diploma in Civil Engineering and at least 2 years of Industry/Estate experience, with age not more than 35 years. Applications are online through a Google Form link, and the last date is 11 December 2026 (Advt. No. 08/2026-27).

age_limit.details: The age limit is not more than 35 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form link given in the advertisement (see Important Links).
Fill in the application form before 11/12/2026.

Give complete and accurate details of educational qualifications, academic performance and relevant work experience. Eligibility is decided solely on the information furnished, and a qualification or experience not claimed or adequately supported will not be considered at any stage.
Enter a correct and active e-mail address. All communications, including the issue of the Admit Card, are sent by e-mail only.
Check all particulars before final submission. A submitted application cannot be modified, edited or resubmitted, and no request for change is entertained.
A candidate wishing to apply for more than one post must submit a separate online application for each post. The notice does not list documents to upload or enclose.
important_instructions: Applications received after the closing date are not considered under any circumstances, even if the online system permits submission. If a candidate gives false, incorrect, incomplete or misleading information, or suppresses a material fact, the candidature is liable to be cancelled. An appointment already made is liable to be terminated. No correspondence or queries about eligibility, application status, postal delays, conduct or result of any test, the selection process or similar matters are entertained. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the advertised post if no suitable candidate is found. The Institute also reserves the right to conduct a trade test for each non-teaching post for candidates shortlisted on the basis of their written test performance, wherever applicable. Any addition, deletion, amendment or corrigendum will be published only on the Institute's website. Disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent Courts at Kolkata, West Bengal. The Director's decision on any dispute or ambiguity is final and binding.

rows.details: National Institute of Technical Teachers' Training & Research, Kolkata
One year, subject to review of performance after six months

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: At least 2 years of Industry/Estate experience in any Govt./Autonomous/Private Institution, including experience in execution, supervision, repair and rehabilitation of buildings and road. Should be able to interpret the civil drawings and perform estimation of work properly. Should have experience in dealing with CPWD, PWD and Municipal bodies, etc. Knowledge of MS Office and Auto-CAD. The age limit is not more than 35 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.essential_qualification: Diploma in Civil Engineering from a reputed Govt./Private Polytechnic.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs.25,000/-. The tenure is one year, subject to review of performance after six months. The post is purely contractual, and the engagement is subject to satisfactory performance. No Travelling Allowance is admissible to candidates appearing for the written test, skill test, interview or any other stage of the selection process.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NITTTR Kolkata Junior Consultant (Civil)
content_sections.text: A candidate wishing to apply for more than one post must submit a separate online application for each post. The notice does not list documents to upload or enclose.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are screened on the information given in the online form. If many applications are received, the Institute may restrict the number of candidates called by adopting higher or additional shortlisting criteria, as recommended by the Screening/Shortlisting Committee. These criteria may be based on academic performance, relevant experience or other objective criteria. Only shortlisted candidates are called for later stages. Alternatively, the Institute may call all applicants for the initial stage without prior scrutiny. Eligibility, qualifications and experience are then verified only for candidates shortlisted for later stages, or at any stage the Institute decides. Candidature found ineligible or based on false information can be cancelled at any stage. Meeting the eligibility criteria alone does not entitle a candidate to be called for any stage. The lists of shortlisted and non-shortlisted candidates will be published on www.nitttrkol.ac.in . Non-shortlisted candidates may send a representation to [email protected] within 07 (seven) days from the date of publication of the lists. Later representations are not entertained. The notice does not give the date or mode of any test or interview.

content_sections.text: Applications received after the closing date are not considered under any circumstances, even if the online system permits submission. If a candidate gives false, incorrect, incomplete or misleading information, or suppresses a material fact, the candidature is liable to be cancelled. An appointment already made is liable to be terminated. No correspondence or queries about eligibility, application status, postal delays, conduct or result of any test, the selection process or similar matters are entertained. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the advertised post if no suitable candidate is found. The Institute also reserves the right to conduct a trade test for each non-teaching post for candidates shortlisted on the basis of their written test performance, wherever applicable. Any addition, deletion, amendment or corrigendum will be published only on the Institute's website. Disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent Courts at Kolkata, West Bengal. The Director's decision on any dispute or ambiguity is final and binding.
